title: HiMA-MDD: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent Harness for Interpretable Multimodal Depression Detection in Clinical Interviews
abstract: arXiv:2608.21868v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Depression assessment from multimodal clinical interviews requires integrating dispersed evidence from multiple symptoms into a coherent PHQ-8 profile. This process is hierarchical: relevant evidence is often sparse and context-dependent within local question-answer exchanges, multiple exchanges jointly support symptom-level judgments, and the final assessment depends on the coherence of the complete symptom profile. Existing LLM systems either process interviews holistically or distribute work across generic agent roles; neither design necessarily provides an explicit orchestration mechanism that coordinates evidence access, item-score authority, bounded feedback, and state recording across these levels. To address this gap, we introduce HiMA-MDD, a hierarchical multi-agent harness that aligns this assessment hierarchy with three agent layers. translated_abstract: 从多模态临床访谈中进行抑郁评估，需要将来自多种症状的分散证据整合成一个连贯的PHQ-8档案。这一过程是分层的：相关证据在局部问答交流中通常稀疏且依赖上下文，多个交流共同支持症状层面的判断，而最终评估取决于完整症状档案的一致性。现有的LLM系统要么整体处理访谈，要么将工作分配给通用智能体角色；这两种设计都不一定提供一种明确的编排机制，用于协调跨这些层次的证据访问、项目评分权威、受限反馈和状态记录。为解决这一差距，我们引入了HiMA-MDD，一种分层多智能体框架，将这一评估层次与三个智能体层对齐。在非智能体预处理构建保留上下文的的多模态问答单元后，第1层负责...
tldr: 本文提出HiMA-MDD，一种分层多智能体框架，通过三层智能体结构显式编排多模态临床访谈中的抑郁评估过程，实现可解释的PHQ-8评分。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HiMA-MDD, a hierarchical multi-agent harness that explicitly orchestrates multimodal depression assessment in clinical interviews through a three-layer agent structure, enabling interpretable PHQ-8 scoring.
